lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in round 5 where the effect was underpredicted.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

candidates.title: Customization Mode Selection Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen before photo upload where users select whether to create a pet from photos or choose a quick styled generator.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high mean duration of 1017s and 60.9% dropoff, alongside support reports of custom pet generation failing.

new_creation_mode.headline: Choose How to Build Your Pet
new_creation_mode.body: Upload photos for custom AI generation or choose a quick pre-built style template.

guard.reason: Adding new screens inside onboarding is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at the highest dropoff step (adoption) with strong evidence, but introduces a new screen.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Status Progress Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen with a visual stage progress indicator and animated status showing pet generation status.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to dropoffs and pet rendering issues.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are preparing your pet animations and desktop interactions.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen retains its core function of showing pet creation progress.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait times on home step; home flow redesigns previously showed minor lift.

candidates.title: First Desktop Pet Interaction Onboarding Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive hands-on step on home_intro where users practice dragging, clicking, and toggling pet controls.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cite confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Pet!
home_intro.body: Try moving your pet around and clicking to open the quick desktop interaction menu.

guard.reason: Adding interactive elements to home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-setup confusion, but major changes to finish step historically hurt conversion significantly.

candidates.title: Defer Account Sign-In to End of Onboarding
candidates.change: Moves sign_in to after pet selection and adoption certificate creation right before waiting.
candidates.why: Sign in drops off 27.1% of users early and causes pet reset confusion when users re-authenticate with different accounts.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in step had no clear positive effect (+1.0%) in previous tests.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Save Clarity Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit sign-in hint explaining that signing in links pets permanently to cloud storage across device reinstalls.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, showing account linkage confusion.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary email to ensure your pet is saved safely to your cloud account.

components.text: Cloud Save Enabled: Syncs your pet and progress automatically.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Exclusive Starter Pet Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Displays an exclusive starter pet badge callout on path selection to motivate path completion.
candidates.why: Path selection shows a high mean duration of 514s despite median 8s, indicating user hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Companion Journey
choose_path.hint: Complete onboarding today to unlock an exclusive Starter Badge for your pet!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free extras/perks and creates artificial urgency ('today').

candidates.title: Background Processing Desktop Notification Option
candidates.change: Enables background waiting toggle with notification option so users know they can minimize the app.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, leading users to close the app early and encounter pet loading bugs.

waiting.body: You can minimize this window. We will send a notification when your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding background processing notifications preserves the waiting screen's purpose.

candidates.score_note: Helps users handle the 2336s mean waiting time without abandoning the app.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Clarity Headline
candidates.change: Replaces finish screen text with explicit instructions on tray icons, shortcut keys, and hide controls.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding regarding hiding, talking to, or controlling the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, feed, or change settings. Access the tray icon for quick options.

guard.reason: Updating text on home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update resolving post-onboarding confusion without altering finish screen structure.

candidates.title: Photo Requirements Clarity Callout
candidates.change: Adds photo formatting and lighting hints directly on the upload screen to improve AI custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual results during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single pet centered in the image.

components.text: Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Clear lighting ensures accurate rendering.

guard.reason: Adding photo formatting hints on upload_photos is valid.

candidates.score_note: Simple hint on the highest dropoff step (adoption) targeting specific user errors reported in support.

candidates.title: Split Screen Path Comparison Layout
candidates.change: Changes path selection to a side-by-side split layout clearly contrasting instant preset vs custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose path drops off 23.8% of users and has high mean time (514s), suggesting ambiguity between paths.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Start?
choose_path.body: Select standard companion for immediate setup or custom generation for a personalized pet.

guard.reason: Split-screen layout maintains both path options (adopting standard companion vs custom creation).

candidates.score_note: Layout change for path selection, which previously showed modest positive movement (+2.5%).

held_by_harm_budget: First Desktop Pet Interaction Onboarding Flow
lessons_next: Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in rounds 5 and 7 where effects were underpredicted.
Adding a new screen during pet adoption (adoption, new_screen) was helpful and won.
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) or introducing new home screen flows (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in pet adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).
